scores.label: Growth mindset
scores.description: Separate descriptive subscale mean; not a latent factor estimate or teaching-quality score.

interpretations.headline: 结果说明
interpretations.interpretation: This profile describes your reported belief or agreement, not how often a strategy happened. The 1–7 mean is a response-category average, not a percentage, norm, student ability or teaching-quality grade. If a practice is working, identify one piece of learning evidence. If implementation feels difficult, consider curriculum constraints and available support before choosing one feasible adjustment.

guidance.text: Choose one recent lesson and ask what pupils said or produced, rather than inferring learning from your intention alone.
Use one small piece of observed learning evidence to choose a next step; seek collaboration when time or curriculum conditions limit what is possible.

limitations: GM and EC describe beliefs/perceived agency; FG is agreement with reported principles; OI is frequency. Do not combine them as one quality score.
Reverse only author-starred GM1/GM5 and EC1–EC6 using 8 minus the raw response. No moral or performance labels.
GM mean is described by the author guide; the other subscales use an explicitly declared project equal-weight descriptive mean, not a published latent-factor scoring key.
Complete-case missing policy is a conservative project choice because the source specifies no missing threshold. Missing and not applicable never become zero.
No local norms, translated-item validation or standalone administration equivalence claimed. Historical learning-style/learning-profile theory is not advice to match teaching to fixed learner types.
